answer: In this PoA system, each node’s reputation decays exponentially with a fixed temporal half-life, so only sustained, honestly useful service preserves influence. EigenTrust factorization and reciprocity-weighted transitivity propagate credit through established edges, while a freshly spawned sybil has near-zero eigenvector centrality and negligible trust mass; it therefore cannot pass consensus, even if it imitates a violet reef or crowds a ledge.
